claims.text: Rain runs down a bus window at night while the city slides past outside.
A large droplet gathers smaller beads and breaks into a wavering downward streak while a passing light flares across the wet glass.
The view opens to more of the window and to horizontal trails of blurred city lights beyond the pane.

soundscape: Soft rain patters against the bus window, with a low engine hum and distant muffled traffic beneath it.

description.text: The vertical frame is filled by the dark glass of a bus window at night, its surface beaded with rain.
Cold city light from beyond the pane smears into soft blue, amber, and white patches, sliding slowly sideways as the bus moves.
Near the center, a large droplet trembles, gathers smaller beads into itself, and breaks into a wavering streak that crawls downward, leaving a thin clear trail through the misted glass.
Faint reflections of the bus interior—dim overhead light and shadowy seat backs—ghost across the lower corner.
A passing light flares softly across the wet surface, briefly brightening the droplets, then fades as the street beyond slips away.
Soft rain patters unevenly on the glass, with a low engine hum underneath.
A large bead of water swells, draws in two smaller beads, and starts a slow crooked descent.
A passing light blooms across the pane, silvering the droplets before the reflection dims.
The view opens toward a wider section of the same rain-streaked window, revealing the vertical pane’s frame and more of the night city beyond.

The nearest droplets soften into blur as focus shifts to the distant street: horizontal trails of headlights, storefront glow, and apartment windows stretch and slide past, interrupted by dark gaps of buildings and trees.
Fresh rain begins to run in thin, winding lines across the foreground glass, occasionally joining into heavier threads.
The city light remains out of focus, a continuous moving ribbon of color against the black night, while the glass keeps its cool blue-gray sheen and the bus interior recedes into shadow at the edges.
The rain thickens into a steady whisper while muffled traffic and the engine drone continue.
Foreground droplets lose definition as distant headlights and shop signs smear into horizontal streaks.
New trails of water lengthen down the glass, bending around older beads and catching faint city color.
